name: bite-size-promo
description: 20-second Bite Size motion-graphics intro, built with Remotion

scripts.finalize: ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/render_raw.mp4 -i public/audio/bite_size_mix.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 320k -t 20 -movflags +faststart out/bite_size_promo.mp4
scripts.audio:app: uv run --no-project python audio/generate_audio.py src/app/timeline_app.json public/audio/bite_size_app_mix.wav audio/cue_sheet_app.json
scripts.finalize:app: ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/render_app_raw.mp4 -i public/audio/bite_size_app_mix.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 320k -t 20 -movflags +faststart out/bite_size_app.mp4
scripts.audio:ref: uv run --no-project python audio/generate_audio.py src/ref/timeline_ref.json public/audio/bite_size_ref_mix.wav audio/cue_sheet_ref.json
scripts.finalize:ref: ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/render_ref_raw.mp4 -i public/audio/bite_size_ref_mix.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 320k -t 20 -movflags +faststart out/bite_size_ref.mp4
scripts.audio:notes: uv run --no-project python audio/generate_audio.py src/notes/timeline_notes.json public/audio/bite_size_notes_mix.wav audio/cue_sheet_notes.json
scripts.finalize:notes: ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/render_notes_raw.mp4 -i public/audio/bite_size_notes_mix.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 320k -t 20 -movflags +faststart out/bite_size_notes.mp4
